Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to perform the core task of reading and extracting specific text from the webpages it opened. Instead of analyzing the content of the search results pages to find the required citations, it only reported the existence of the search engine interface and a list of links. It never navigated to the actual Britannica, Khan Academy, or National Geographic pages to read the text confirming that leaves are the primary site of photosynthesis. This failure to execute the browsing and reading capability meant no credible quotes were ever gathered, despite the Planner's repeated instructions to do so.
